title: TikTok changed the rules of the marketing game — but what now?
excerpt: From the moment it launched, TikTok has earned the status of not just an entertainment phenomenon but a key player in the social media market. The platform has revolutionized the way we spend time online, pulling in millions of users worldwide, younger generations above all. Its effect on marketing is just as significant — it is changing the way brands build a presence and engage an audience.
metaTitle: TikTok changed the marketing game - but what now?
metaDescription: TikTok rewrote how brands reach an audience. What it changed, where it is already banned, and what marketers would do if it disappeared tomorrow.

runs.text: The platform has revolutionized the way we spend time online, pulling in millions of users worldwide, younger generations above all. Its effect on marketing is just as significant — it is changing the way brands build a presence and engage an audience. In this article we look at how TikTok has changed marketing, and at what could happen if the platform suddenly disappeared from the market.
TikTok's effect on marketing

TikTok brought in a new era of advertising, built on short, high-energy videos with the potential to spread across the web at a dizzying pace. What makes TikTok so effective in marketing? Authenticity and creativity are the key here. Unlike more traditional forms of advertising, TikTok promotes content that is natural and often engaging in a funny or emotional way.
A few brands have made excellent use of TikTok's potential:
iRobot

The brand behind the popular Roomba robot vacuums uses TikTok effectively to show how practical its products are. Campaigns and creative videos showing how iRobot's machines handle everyday challenges have proved very popular. TikTok users often share their own experiences with iRobot products, which leads to more brand awareness and positive reviews.

Pracuj.pl

This Polish job platform uses TikTok to reach younger job seekers and professionals who are active on social media. Through creative, engaging content — career advice, trending challenges, success stories — Pracuj.pl has built a strong presence on TikTok. That has let it reach potential candidates and employers in a modern and effective way.
<a0>@pracuj.pl</a0>
Stadler Form

A brand specializing in air quality products such as humidifiers and purifiers uses TikTok to show off the benefits its products bring. Stadler Form's TikTok campaigns often show how its devices make life more comfortable in all sorts of situations, and they offer tips on keeping a healthy environment at home. The engaging videos raise the brand's visibility and build trust with potential customers.
<a0>@stadlerformpolska</a0>
Bans in other countries

TikTok is not welcome everywhere. In India the platform was banned over concerns about data security and its effect on young people. In the United States, even though the formal bans have been put on hold, data privacy is still a contentious subject. In Europe too there are concerns about personal data protection and regulatory compliance.

If TikTok were banned in Poland, it could leave a hole in a lot of companies' marketing strategies. Marketers would have to change where they put their budgets, leaning harder on Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, which already work as TikTok alternatives. The internet always fills a vacuum, though, which could open the door for other platforms to grow and pull those users in. Brands would have to watch their target groups even more closely and fit their strategies to wherever their audience naturally moved.
Plan for the changes you cannot plan

TikTok is an example of how new technology can shape marketing and the way brands engage an audience. Its impact on social media is hard to overstate, and it also shows how a fast-changing technology landscape demands flexibility from marketers and a readiness to adapt. Following trends and innovation is key to staying competitive in a marketing world that keeps shifting. With TikTok's future uncertain, being able to fit your strategy to a new reality becomes essential.
